caseName: Tschanz v. Sweetwater County School District No. One
caseNameFull: Tschanz v. Sweetwater County School District Number One Johnson v. Oppel

opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir.; and

C. A. 8th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until November 10, 1997, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
